svg.title: GROOVE: time-indexed constraints, full-chunk QPs, and protected selection
svg.desc: One raw action chunk is integrated into a path. Fourteen fixed constraint configurations each place a separate oriented box at every raw-path timestamp. Fourteen history-conditioned QPs each optimize the entire chunk. The selector scores only the committed prefix and executes one selected prefix. Paths and scores are computed on a synthetic example, not benchmark results.

g.text: Each set: one box at every timestamp
Next replan: update history, observe, and query the VLA.
k: setting · t: timestamp · H: chunk length · C: executed commands
